_comment: Time-boxed exceptions to the Trivy gate, approved by the owner on 2026-11-27. Each one covers one advisory of one package at one fixed version and stops applying on its date, or when security/check_nginx_features.py finds a feature the advisory needs. Remove an entry as soon as the fix is installed.

accepted.reason: Needs the mail proxy. This site only serves HTTP and proxies three GET routes. Nginx 1.30.7 is not yet published in nginx-unprivileged or Alpine.
Needs HTTP/3 (QUIC). Not enabled. Nginx 1.30.7 is not yet published.
Needs HTTP/2. The only listener is plain HTTP/1.1 on port 8080. Nginx 1.30.7 is not yet published.
Needs HTTP/2 for client connections. Not enabled. Nginx 1.30.7 is not yet published.
Needs a listen directive with the ssl parameter. This container terminates no TLS. Nginx 1.30.7 is not yet published.
Needs an SSI or mirror subrequest to a location that resolves the same proxied name. Neither is enabled. Nginx 1.30.7 is not yet published.
